notes: Base 8.08366 cm matches my 0.080837 m. R answers verified: 343*1.34/5091.75 = 9.0268 cm, 343*1.52/5091.75 = 10.2393 cm, 343*1.75/5091.75 = 11.7887 cm. In pass 1 I labelled the diameter sentences C; the authors label them K with a thin-rod regime (10 d < L). Both readings are defensible: the area cancels from sqrt(E/rho) only while the rod is thin (Rayleigh lateral-inertia correction scales as (d/lambda)^2, negligible at 8 mm vs 2.4 m), so K with that regime is acceptable; the regime threshold is a crude but correct-side criterion and all listed values (6.5-13 mm) lie well inside it. Minimal pairs T2604/TD83B (railing vs rod) and TA297/T3295 (earlier run vs before clamp) carry the same 32 cm and differ only in attachment. Numeral-free controls TFBD6/TFE55 are by design. Different area and diameter values (1.6 cm^2 vs 8.21 mm -> 0.53 cm^2) never appear together, so no contradiction.
